title: When PTQ Calibration Helps or Hurts: Dose-Driven Collapse and Validation-Gated Abstention in Quantized Text Embedders
abstract: arXiv:2610.27397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learned post-training quantization (PTQ) calibration fits quantizer parameters on a small calibration set, and for a text embedder the natural supervision is retrieval relevance. We ask two questions that are usually conflated: how far to calibrate, and whether to calibrate at all. Across three embedders (e5-base-v2, BGE-M3, EmbeddingGemma-300m) at 4-bit weight quantization, 161 calibration runs, the outcome of a fixed procedure ranges from a gain to catastrophic degradation, and the driver is the dose of the update, measured as the functional displacement D_func of the quantized model from its uncalibrated start. On EmbeddingGemma the same learning-rate grid gives +1.47 to -71.53 points of in-domain NDCG@10 change; a label-free cosine objective collapses at the same dose (-69.52 vs -71.63), so the collapse is a property of learnable calibration rather than of retrieval supervision. Objective sensitivity is heterogeneous: on e5, ranking

translated_title: PTQ校准何时有益何时有害：量化文本嵌入器中剂量驱动的崩溃与验证门控的放弃
translated_abstract: 学习式训练后量化（PTQ）校准是在小规模校准集上拟合量化器参数，而对文本嵌入器而言，自然的监督信号是检索相关性。我们提出了两个通常被混淆的问题：校准到什么程度，以及是否应该校准。在三个嵌入器（e5-base-v2、BGE-M3、EmbeddingGemma-300m）的4位权重量化设置下，经过161次校准运行，同一固定程序的结果从性能提升到灾难性退化不等，而决定因素是更新的“剂量”，以量化模型相对于其未校准起点的函数位移D_func来衡量。在EmbeddingGemma上，相同的学习率网格产生的域内NDCG@10变化范围为+1.47到-71.53分；无标签的余弦目标函数在相同剂量下同样崩溃（-69.52对比-71.63），说明崩溃是可学习校准本身的属性，而非检索监督所致。目标函数敏感性是异质的：在e5上，排序（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了PTQ校准的效果由更新“剂量”（函数位移D_func）驱动，过度校准会导致灾难性崩溃且崩溃源于可学习校准本身而非检索监督，因此应通过验证门控机制选择性地放弃校准。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that PTQ calibration outcomes are driven by the update "dose" (functional displacement D_func), where excessive calibration causes catastrophic collapse—a property of learnable calibration itself rather than retrieval supervision—and proposes validation-gated abstention as the solution.
